long_biography.plain_text:
Acquiring a large development portfolio from insurer a.s.r. changed Bart Meijer's MRP from an investment manager into a full property-development platform. The transaction brought projects and experienced staff together, giving the company a base for inner-city regeneration in Amsterdam, Utrecht and The Hague.

Meijer approaches development by mapping construction possibilities and costs with the contractor before asking architects to refine a design. That sequence is intended to limit build risk without sacrificing finishes or liveability. His mixed-use projects combine homes with workspaces, shops and community facilities. At Cartesius in Utrecht, health research and neighbourhood design are being developed through partnerships with universities, housing organisations and public authorities.

Although MRP's headquarters are located in Amsterdam, Mr Meijer lives with his wife and four kids in Brasschaat, just across the Dutch-Belgian border.

uncertainties.detail: Bart Meijer is a common Dutch name and search results include unrelated academics, executives and professionals. The accepted identity requires the combined MRP, Dutch, Belgian-residence and age context. Namesake-only results were rejected.

MRP's team page sometimes shortens Meijer's role to founder, but the corporate heritage page establishes that Bart and Ton Meijer co-founded Meijer Realty Partners. PropertyNL documented Bart's 90% majority ownership and Ton's 10% minority holding in 2017; MRP later reported that Ton sold his shares, and current material calls Bart the owner. The dossier therefore uses co-founder in the narrative while retaining Founder as the primary relationship classification.

Meijer did not inherit MRP as an existing core asset: he co-founded it and held the substantial majority stake. His father's co-founding participation, minority stake, established property career and the wider family's century-long industry platform nevertheless constitute a material starting advantage, so Self-made — advantaged start is more accurate than either Inherited or an independent-start claim.

Current MRP material explicitly identifies Bart Meijer as owner and chief executive. Ofer Gilboa leads MRP Investment, Daniël van Dongen is chief financial officer and other executives hold distinct functions. The dossier does not attribute their operational responsibilities to Meijer and does not reduce his role to executive-only management.

MRP's founder interview establishes The Hague as Meijer's birthplace, and independent reporting gives an age consistent with the stored 1968 year. No strong public source found a middle name or secondary nationality. Private household information in the existing biography was deliberately excluded.
Focused exact-name, company-name and site:forbes.com/profile searches found no dedicated Forbes profile or reliable subject article for Bart Meijer.

The existing LinkedIn URL matches Meijer Realty Partners, The Hague-area business geography and current MRP activity; official and independent company evidence supplies the necessary cross-corroboration. No personal Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube, TikTok or personal website was verified, so none is proposed.
The supplied relationship context was used only to disambiguate the frozen owner record. Neither biography contains vessel information, and no wealth classification relies on vessel ownership.
